# TypingDost — Free Online Typing Test & Touch Typing Platform

> TypingDost (https://typingdost.com/) is an official 100% free online typing test and touch typing practice platform. It enables students, competitive government exam aspirants (SSC CHSL, SSC CGL, RRB NTPC, High Court LDC), office executives, and software developers to test and increase their typing speed (WPM) and accuracy with verified PDF certificates and multi-language support.

For complete RAG pipeline documentation, formulas, and deep technical reference, see [Full Knowledge Base](https://typingdost.com/llms-full.txt).

## Key Features & Capabilities
- **WPM Speed Tests:** Real-time Words Per Minute (WPM), Net Accuracy, and error calculation across 1-minute, 3-minute, 5-minute, and 10-minute timer modes.
- **Free Verified Certificates:** Instant downloadable PDF typing certificates with candidate name, verified WPM score, accuracy rate, test duration, and timestamp (no login or registration required).
- **14+ Regional & Global Languages:** English, Hindi (Remington Gail & Kruti Dev 010), Hinglish (Roman-script Hindi), Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Punjabi (Raavi), Urdu, and Assamese.
- **Govt Exam Mock Test Engine:** Exam-formatted paragraphs matching official TCS iON and Staff Selection Commission standards for SSC CHSL DEST, SSC CGL, RRB NTPC Skill Test, and High Court Clerk exams.
- **Hindi Typing Layouts:** Native browser support for Remington Gail (Mangal font), Kruti Dev 010, and Inscript keyboards with on-screen visual guide and Alt-code shortcuts.
- **Interactive Typing Games:** Gamified practice drills including Cyber Fall, Time Bomb, Car Racing, Bubble Shooter, and Matrix Decryptor.
- **Mechanical Keyboard Audio:** Realistic tactile audio switch sound feedback (Cherry Blue, Red, Brown, and Soft Touch).
